title: Project skeleton and AGENTS.md
lead: Create the Python package, test harness and agent/contributor guide.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** Flask, config, database or any feature code.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: There is no code yet. Every later slice needs an importable package, a test command that works, and an AGENTS.md that states the project's rules (stdlib-first, ask before adding dependencies, no commits unless asked).

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None beyond the tooling interview. The license is decided (AGPL-3.0; `LICENSE` already exists).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `pyproject.toml`: setuptools backend, `requires-python = ">=3.12"`, `license = "AGPL-3.0-only"`, ruff config (`target-version = "py312"`)
- `requirements.in` (Flask) and `requirements-dev.in` (`-c requirements.txt`, ruff, pip-tools)
- `requirements.txt`, `requirements-dev.txt` (compiled with hashes)
- `src/larder/__init__.py` (version)
- `tests/__init__.py`, `tests/test_smoke.py`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `.gitignore` (exists; extend if the tooling adds caches)
- `README.md` (development section)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Create `src/larder/` and `tests/` per ADR 0017; every `.py` file starts with `# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only`.
2. Write the smoke test; see it fail, then add `__version__`.
3. Write `requirements.in` and `requirements-dev.in`; ask the owner before running `pip-compile --generate-hashes` (network); review the resolved Flask tree (ADR 0008).
4. Write AGENTS.md: project summary; the ADR 0017 setup, test, lint and format commands; dependency policy (ask first; stdlib-first; Flask is the only approved runtime dependency; ruff and pip-tools are dev-only); secrets policy; household-specific data only in the gitignored `local/` folder; commit message style; links to `docs/`; slicer usage.
5. Add a development quick start to README (the ADR 0017 commands).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- In a fresh venv on Python ≥ 3.12: `pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt` and `pip install --no-deps -e .` succeed.
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passes.
- `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass.
- `python -c "import larder"` works.
- `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
